results.title: Moscow To Host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships Despite Ukraine Invasion
results.content: The International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) announced Sunday that Moscow will stage the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships, making it the first Olympic sports federation to award a global event to Russia since the country’s invasion of Ukraine began in 2022.
